sessions.notes_text:
### Contact Summary
Completed initial intake consultation with Tyler Kershaw. Explained Turn90 program expectations, including the Monday-Friday 9 AM - 3 PM schedule, $450/week stipend, job training, forklift certification, and the point system for attendance. Tyler was released from Broad River Correctional on July 1st after serving a 13-year sentence for armed robbery and weapon possession. He is on state supervision until 2028. Tyler is currently stable, living with his fiancé in a rented townhouse, and reported having no emergency needs. 

### Case Plan Goal Progress
Client is on a 3-4 week waitlist for the Turn90 program. Primary immediate goal is to secure interim employment while waiting for program admission.

### Briefcase & Gate 1-4 Updates
- SS Card: Pending (Client states it is arriving in the mail).
- State ID / Birth Certificate: Client states he has these.
- Driver's License: Suspended.
- Transportation: Relying on Uber (Client noted this is costly and needs a more sustainable backup plan).
- Resume: None (Client has no prior work history as he was incarcerated at age 17). 

### Referrals/Resources Provided
- Will create and provide a functional resume based on client's GED and any skills acquired during incarceration.
- Will send information on the Scout Motors job fair happening on the 12th.
- Will send leads for second-chance employers in the Columbia area.

### Next Steps
- Daisy to draft a resume and send it to Tyler.
- Daisy to text job fair details and interim employment leads.
- Tyler to attend the job fair and apply for interim roles.
- Follow up regarding receipt of his Social Security card.
